verdict.rationale: Aircall's developer docs include a first-party guide to creating a webhook and listening to Aircall events, plus a separate guide to tracking SMS activity through messaging webhooks. Together these show registrable outbound HTTP callbacks for call and messaging events. The evidence consists only of tutorial summaries, so the depth of the capability is not shown. Missing for 10: a documented event catalog and subscription-management details, delivery guarantees or signature verification, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
